description: ABLATION STUDY - Single-Modal Baseline. Fair comparison dengan dual-modal: same dataset/split/epochs/batch, DIFFERENT architecture (no HTR discriminator input, no CTC loss). Config adapted untuk single-modal (no warmup/annealing, simplified loss).
_comment_recognizer: Single-modal TIDAK menggunakan recognizer di discriminator, tapi tetap load untuk konsistensi evaluasi
_comment_training: SAME as dual-modal untuk fair comparison
_comment_warmup: DIFFERENT: Single-modal tidak butuh curriculum learning (no HTR to integrate)
_comment_lr: SAME base LR magnitude, simplified schedule (no warmup needed)
_comment_loss_weights: DIFFERENT: Rebalanced tanpa CTC/rec_feat. Total magnitude comparable dengan dual-modal.
_comment_adaptive: DIFFERENT: Adaptive balancing disabled (tidak ada multi-modal untuk dibalance)

discriminator_config._comment: Config untuk single-modal discriminator (no cross-modal attention)
